messages:
sara: FYI — support reported customers confused: Console shows 'v1 pinned' but requests without x-api-version are getting served by v2 during peak. appears after the new fallback policy.

marta: can you share an example? Console pin state is currently just UI state; runtime doesn't read console pins.

kevin: runtime change yesterday: fallback picks next variant when available_capacity < 70. That intentionally makes pins soft unless a header/cookie enforces stickiness.

sara: sample: POST /generate, x-tenant: acme-co, no x-api-version -> runtime route=v2-large reason=fallback_capacity. Console: preferred=v1 pinned=true. Customer sees mismatch.

li: product impact: we need to avoid the perception of lying UI. short-term: change Console copy to "Pinned (soft)" and show a badge when recent routing shows divergence. long-term: add a tenant routing policy (soft, prefer, hard).

kevin: technical notes: hard pin implies scheduler reservations or prioritized allocation — increases cost. prefer could be implemented by boosting candidate score instead of reserving. also propose adding per-request tag routing.reason with values {header, cookie, pin_hint, fallback_capacity, fallback_incompat}.

marta: +1 on routing.reason. Console can use that metric to compute divergence. i'll add a sampled event containing pin_hint when present so we can backfill analysis for the last 48h.

sara: ops ask: can we expose a migration banner telling customers about soft pins changing?

li: yes, will draft banner: "Pinned versions are soft: runtime may fallback under capacity constraints. See docs for hard-pin options." will loop in legal/support.

ops-bot: route-policy-service v1.5.0 deployed 2025-11-05T14:22Z — fallback threshold set to 70% (changelog #2401).

kevin: action items: 1) marta to emit routing.reason and pin_hint sampling; 2) kevin to write prefer/hard design doc (cost tradeoffs); 3) li to update Console copy + banner; 4) sara to create Grafana panel for tenant divergence and a pager rule for sudden spikes.

marta: starting PR for sampled pin_hint trace and routing.reason tag.

kevin: drafting design doc now; will include autoscaler interactions and suggested gating (Dedicated or paid SLA).

li: will share banner copy tomorrow.

sara: thanks — please ping if you see major tenant divergence spikes. closing here.
